Senses.PreferredTarget: awakening through sound and illumination through form
AlternateTargets: hear sound and awaken to the Way; see form and clarify mind
SearchAliases: awakening through sound and illumination through form
awaken to the Way on hearing sound and illuminate mind on seeing form
Senses.Note: The two clauses form one jointly raised couplet. Masters demonstrate it, interrogate its sound-form and mind terms, or reject the search it appears to prescribe.

Senses.Explanation: Awaken to the Way on hearing sound; illuminate mind on seeing form is a paired maxim jointly raised and worked as one unit. Yunmen Wenyan raises both clauses before the Guanyin bread exchange. Yangqi Fanghui demonstrates the pair with hand gestures; Qianyan Yuanzhang and Baiyun Shouduan quote Yunmen; Daochang Mingbian and Daxiao Xingchong qualify the pair as an unnecessary or still-incomplete approach.
